titleZh: 脾氣暴躁 ↔ 和藹可親
hook: 熱可樂一開就炸，對面卻始終春風笑。
script: 左邊 choleric、irascible、peevish——點火就爆；右邊 affable、genial、amiable——誰來都好說話。

members.senseAnchor: easily moved to anger; - H.G.Wells; quickly aroused to anger
members.speakLineEn: A choleric referee escalated every dispute.
members.speakLineZh: 易怒的裁判讓每個爭議都升級。

members.speakLineEn: The irascible professor dismissed soft questions.
members.speakLineZh: 暴躁教授直接打發軟問題。

members.speakLineEn: Peevish objections rarely improve the draft.
members.speakLineZh: 壞脾氣的反對很少能改好草稿。

related.synonyms: cranky, fractious, irritable, nettlesome, peckish, pettish

members.speakLineEn: An affable chair kept the panel constructive.
members.speakLineZh: 和藹的主席讓座談保持建設性。

members.senseAnchor: diffusing warmth and friendliness; of or relating to the chin or median part of the lower jaw
members.speakLineEn: His genial tone disarmed hostile reviewers.
members.speakLineZh: 他溫和的語氣化解了敵意審稿人。

related.antonyms: surly, aloof, hostile, unfriendly, physical, unkind

members.speakLineEn: Amiable colleagues still need clear standards.
members.speakLineZh: 親切同事依然需要清楚標準。

pitfalls: amiable 指人緣好；amicable 常指關係／協議和睦——形近
